// reactive to audio fft : drive osc frequency from low band, saturate
// from high band. Bind the four sliders fft0..fft3 to MIDI/OSC for live
// performance, or animate them by hand to see the effect.
osc(() => 20 + a.fft[0] * 60, 0.1, 1.0)
  .modulate(noise(() => 2 + a.fft[1] * 5, 0.3), () => 0.1 + a.fft[2] * 0.4)
  .saturate(() => 1 + a.fft[3] * 3)
  .out()
